items: In 2025, restaurant brands used Momos to cut manual work, fix incidents faster, raise guest satisfaction and bring guests back more often across their locations.
New AI tools summarized tickets and customers, kept replies in line with brand guidelines, and sent mobile operator reports so local teams could fix issues on the spot.
Marketing teams gained campaign goal tracking, Google menu management, listings management and social media management to keep every location accurate and visible.
Integrations with Paytronix, Square and Otter connected loyalty, post-order feedback and revenue recovery, and 2026 brings stronger AI copilots and a refreshed Unified Inbox.
